pairs: These are the lodging places of the sons of Israel,
qui egressi sunt de Ægypto per turmas suas in manu Moysi et Aaron,
who departed from Egypt by their companies under the hand of Moses and Aaron,
quas descripsit Moyses juxta castrorum loca,
which Moses wrote down according to the places of the encampments,
which they changed upon the order of the Lord.
Profecti igitur de Ramesse mense primo,
Thus the sons of Israel set out from Rameses in the first month,
on the fifteenth day of the first month,
on the day after the Passover,
being seen by all the Egyptians.
And these were burying their firstborn,
quos percusserat Dominus (nam et in diis eorum exercuerat ultionem),
whom the Lord had struck down (for so, too, did he carry out retribution against their gods).
And they made camp at Soccoth.
Et de Soccoth venerunt in Etham,
And from Soccoth they went to Etham,
quæ est in extremis finibus solitudinis.
which is at the furthest limits of the wilderness.
Departing from there, they arrived opposite Pi-hahiroth,
and they were encamped before Migdol.
transierunt per medium mare in solitudinem:
they crossed through the middle of the Sea into the wilderness.
et ambulantes tribus diebus per desertum Etham,
And having walked for three days through the desert of Etham,
where there were twelve fountains of water
And they set up camp there.
they fixed their tents above the Red Sea.
And setting out from the Red Sea,
they were encamped in the desert of Sin.
they fixed their tents at Rephidim,
ubi populo defuit aqua ad bibendum.
where the people lacked water to drink.
they camped in the desert of Sinai.
Sed et de solitudine Sinai egressi,
But departing also from the wilderness of the Sinai,
they arrived at the Graves of Lust.
And setting out from the Graves of Lust,
Et de Haseroth venerunt in Rethma.
And from Hazeroth, they went to Rithmah.
And departing from there, they arrived at Libnah.
De Lebna castrametati sunt in Ressa.
From Libnah, they made camp at Rissah.
they were encamped at mount Shepher.
they pitched their tents at Mithkah.
Et de Jetebatha venerunt in Hebrona.
And from Jotbathah, they went to Abronah.
they went into the desert of Sin,
at the furthermost limits of the land of Edom.
Ascenditque Aaron sacerdos in montem Hor jubente Domino:
And Aaron the priest ascended onto mount Hor, by the order of the Lord.
et ibi mortuus est anno quadragesimo egressionis filiorum Israël ex Ægypto,
And there he died, in the fortieth year of the departure of the sons of Israel from Egypt,
on the first day of the month,
cum esset annorum centum viginti trium.
when he was one hundred twenty-three years old.
in terram Chanaan venisse filios Israël.
heard that the sons of Israel had arrived in the land of Canaan.
And setting out from mount Hor,
Et de Oboth venerunt in Ijeabarim,
And from Oboth, they went to Iye-abarim,
which is at the borders of the Moabites.
they fixed their tents at Dibon-gad.
venerunt ad montes Abarim contra Nabo.
they went to the mountains of Abarim, opposite Nebo.
And setting out from the mountains of Abarim,
they crossed over to the plains of Moab,
Ibique castrametati sunt de Bethsimoth usque ad Abelsatim in planioribus locis Moabitarum.
And they made camp there, from Beth-jeshimoth all the way to Abel-shittim, in the level places of the Moabites,
Ubi locutus est Dominus ad Moysen:
where the Lord said to Moses:
When you will have crossed over the Jordan,
entering into the land of Canaan,
destroy all the inhabitants of that land.
and lay waste to every exalted thing,
Ego enim dedi vobis illam in possessionem,
For I have given it you as a possession,
which you shall divide among you by lot.
To the greater number you shall give more,
and to the lesser number, less.
To each one, just as the lot shall fall,
so shall the inheritance be distributed.
Per tribus et familias possessio dividetur.
The possession shall be divided by the tribes and families.
Sin autem nolueritis interficere habitatores terræ:
But if you are not willing to put to death the inhabitants of the land,
qui remanserint, erunt vobis quasi clavi in oculis, et lanceæ in lateribus,
those who remain shall be to you like spikes in your eyes and lances in your sides,
et adversabuntur vobis in terra habitationis vestræ:
and they shall be adversaries to you in the land of your habitation.
